{{Top|leg}}
'''Mon Calamari Extreme''' was the designation given to the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] just beyond the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] during the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Defense of Mon Calamari]], which precluded the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==History==
The [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] monitored the location, where it was expected that the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]] commanded by [[Warmaster]] [[Nas Choka]] would revert from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in order to commence the battle. [[Iceberg Three]] was located near the region during the battle, although its orbit only carried it through Mon Calamari Extreme at certain times. The [[Twin Suns Squadron|Twin Suns]], [[Vanguard Squadron (Hapes)|Vanguard]], [[Scimitar Squadron (New Republic)|Scimitar]], and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadrons]] met in this area to contended with an advance portion of the Yuuzhan Vong [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="TUF" />
